conv0_sessions2.text: Hey Mel! Good to see you! How have you been?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Hey Caroline! Good to see you! I'm swamped with the kids & work. What's up with you? Anything new?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Wow, that's cool, Caroline! What happened that was so awesome? Did you hear any inspiring stories?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: The transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all the support. [shared image: a photo of a dog walking past a wall with a painting of a woman]

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Wow, love that painting! So cool you found such a helpful group. What's it done for you?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: The support group has made me feel accepted and given me courage to embrace myself.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: That's really cool. You've got guts. What now?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: Gonna continue my edu and check out career options, which is pretty exciting!

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Wow, Caroline! What kinda jobs are you thinkin' of? Anything that stands out?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: I'm keen on counseling or working in mental health - I'd love to support those with similar issues.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: You'd be a great counselor! Your empathy and understanding will really help the people you work with. By the way, take a look at this. [shared image: a photo of a painting of a sunset over a lake]

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: Thanks, Melanie! That's really sweet. Is this your own painting?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Yeah, I painted that lake sunrise last year! It's special to me.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: Wow, Melanie! The colors really blend nicely. Painting looks like a great outlet for expressing yourself.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Thanks, Caroline! Painting's a fun way to express my feelings and get creative. It's a great way to relax after a long day.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: Totally agree, Mel. Relaxing and expressing ourselves is key. Well, I'm off to go do some research.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Yep, Caroline. Taking care of ourselves is vital. I'm off to go swimming with the kids. Talk to you soon!

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Hey Caroline, since we last chatted, I've had a lot of things happening to me. I ran a charity race for mental health last Saturday – it was really rewarding. Really made me think about taking care of our minds.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: That charity race sounds great, Mel! Making a difference & raising awareness for mental health is super rewarding - I'm really proud of you for taking part!

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Thanks, Caroline! The event was really thought-provoking. I'm starting to realize that self-care is really important. It's a journey for me, but when I look after myself, I'm able to better look after my family.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: I totally agree, Melanie. Taking care of ourselves is so important - even if it's not always easy. Great that you're prioritizing self-care.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Yeah, it's tough. So I'm carving out some me-time each day - running, reading, or playing my violin - which refreshes me and helps me stay present for my fam!

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: That's great, Mel! Taking time for yourself is so important. You're doing an awesome job looking after yourself and your family!

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Thanks, Caroline. It's still a work in progress, but I'm doing my best. My kids are so excited about summer break! We're thinking about going camping next month. Any fun plans for the summer?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: Researching adoption agencies — it's been a dream to have a family and give a loving home to kids who need it.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Wow, Caroline! That's awesome! Taking in kids in need - you're so kind. Your future family is gonna be so lucky to have you!

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: Thanks, Mel! My goal is to give kids a loving home. I'm truly grateful for all the support I've got from friends and mentors. Now the hard work starts to turn my dream into a reality. And here's one of the adoption agencies I'm looking into. It's a lot to take in, but I'm feeling hopeful and optimistic. [shared image: a photography of a sign for a new arrival and an information and domestic building]

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: Wow, that agency looks great! What made you pick it?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: I chose them 'cause they help LGBTQ+ folks with adoption. Their inclusivity and support really spoke to me.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: That's great, Caroline! Loving the inclusivity and support. Anything you're excited for in the adoption process?

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: I'm thrilled to make a family for kids who need one. It'll be tough as a single parent, but I'm up for the challenge!

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: You're doing something amazing! Creating a family for those kids is so lovely. You'll be an awesome mom! Good luck!

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Caroline
conv0_sessions2.text: Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words really mean a lot. I'll do my best to make sure these kids have a safe and loving home.

conv0_sessions2.speaker: Melanie
conv0_sessions2.text: No doubts, Caroline. You have such a caring heart - they'll get all the love and stability they need! Excited for this new chapter!

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Deborah
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Jolene
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: Why does it hold such special memories for you?

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Deborah
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Jolene
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Deborah
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Jolene
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris.

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Deborah
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother. And what is special for you about your jewelry?

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Jolene
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Deborah
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: It should really give you strength and energy!

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Deborah
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Jolene
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: What inspired you to go down this route?

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Deborah
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.

conv7_sessions1_no_captions.speaker: Jolene
conv7_sessions1_no_captions.text: Looking forward to the next chat!
